_note: DRAFT - not loaded. design/11-crafting-depth-v0.md. skill: the crafting skill; trivial: the skill at which it stops teaching and can no longer fail; min_skill: the least skill that may try it; tool: the tool kind and tier needed (returned, wears). Every recipe in items-full-v0.json, grouped by station (generated from the items' own 'recipe' fields; the item is the source of truth). grade: the station grade needed (bands 1-2 grade 1, 3-4 grade 2, ...). stars: the stars you need to work the materials yourself. fee: dollars paid for the station (and, for Fine work, the master's time). makes: how many come out. hours: world-clock hours. A recipe's output never sells for more than its inputs plus fee (design/10 section 12).

rules._note: design/11 section 4. Every number is a first guess [MODEL].
rules.skill_cap_by_stars: none (Brent 2026-10-18): any crafting skill can reach 300 at any star
rules.affinity_shards: anyone may dowse for them; trivial +100 over the band's (to 300), found at 0.2% a dowse below trivial and 1% at or past it [B: open to all, very very hard]
rules.trivial: 25 x (band - 1) + offset (gather 6, refine 8, subcombine 12, plain 16, fine 22, runed 24)
rules.attempt_from: trivial - 30 (the recipe is greyed out below that)
rules.success: clamp(0.05, 0.95, 0.70 + (effective skill - trivial) / 50 + 0.03 x (tool tier - tier needed) + station bonus); at or past trivial + 13 a combine cannot fail
rules.effective_skill: skill + 5 per guild mark held in that skill (marks at 50, 100, 150, 200, 250; each needs a witnessed masterwork)
rules.failure: the fee is spent; each input is returned with chance 0.5 (+0.1 per station grade above the recipe's, + the salvage of a field kit's grade 0); tools lose a use either way
rules.skill_up: only below trivial: chance = 0.35 x sqrt((trivial - skill) / 25), capped at 0.60, halved on a failure; first success of any recipe gives +1 for sure; at most +1 per combine
rules.tool_wear: a tool is returned on every combine and loses one use; at 0 uses it breaks
rules.crafting_time: each combine takes the recipe's hours on the world clock (a day is 90 real minutes)
rules.growth: proposed: a combine of your own band or above, below trivial, adds a little latent aura [F: crafting is a source of latent aura - bible LAW 2]; nothing at or past trivial
